name: 미세표정 분석
description: 비디오에서 부자연스러운 미세표정과 얼굴 동작 단위 패턴을 감지합니다.
useCase: Identifying deepfakes through abnormal facial muscle movement patterns
mechanism: Analyzes Facial Action Coding System (FACS) action units to detect micro-expressions - brief, involuntary facial movements lasting 40-200ms. Deepfake videos often lack natural micro-expressions, show impossible AU combinations, or exhibit delayed/absent emotional transitions.
source: Agarwal, S. et al. (2020) - Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Aural and Oral Dynamics, CVPR Workshop
algorithm: AU Detection (OpenFace) + Temporal Pattern Analysis + FACS Plausibility Verification
parameters: AU detection: 17 core AUs, Temporal resolution: 40ms, Window: 200ms sliding, Threshold: AU probability > 0.5
